comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Example apps and checked examples
themes.text: The chat app uses WebSockets, and the poll app uses server-sent events. You can start a real project from either one. Every block of code on this website is run by a test, or it says why it is not. Each page shows the `nvs.toml` settings that its examples run with.

themes.title: JSON in web pages, and queue jobs
themes.text: `Core\Json::encode` escapes `<`, `>`, `&` and `'` in the text it writes. So you can put its output inside an HTML page or a `<script>` tag. A queue job's id has a string form, and a later request can find the job with it. A guessed or changed id finds no job. `Core\Response::stream` sends the pieces that `Core\Json::encodeEach` gives.

themes.title: Markdown
themes.text: `Core\Markdown` converts Markdown to HTML, and HTML to Markdown. It converts a whole document, or a document in pieces while it arrives. Every example of the CommonMark and GitHub Flavored Markdown specifications passes. The time it needs grows in step with the size of the input. The package registry uses it to show the readme of each package version on its page.
